verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email client, but the evidence shows no self-hosted deployment of Missive. A community report notes that emails are fetched via Missive's own servers. Connecting to your own IMAP/SMTP servers, including ones with self-signed certificates, is a different capability and does not make the app itself self-hostable.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
